repo.name: Vivid
repo.description: Vivid - Open Source IRL Streaming App with Chat Bot & AI Features

en-US.description:
Vivid is an open-source IRL streaming application for Android.

Features:
- Live streaming via RTMP/SRT to Twitch, YouTube, Kick, and custom platforms
- Real-time chat overlay with badges and emotes
- AI-powered chat bot with configurable responses
- Owner remote control commands
- Dark mode with AMOLED support
- Multi-language support (English, German, French)
- Scene management and auto-switching
- Real-time GPS overlay (altitude, speed, coordinates)
- Custom RTMP/SRT endpoints

Open Source: https://github.com/thoser666/Vivid
Issues: https://github.com/thoser666/Vivid/issues
